name: mumuy/pacman
embed_notes: index.html + static/script/game.js (tiny stage engine) + index.js (game). No build. Chinese comments/UI text.
reskin_notes: No sprite files: Pac-Man, ghosts and maze are drawn procedurally with canvas paths; colors and maze data are literals inside index.js. Reskin = editing draw code and color constants; font is PressStart2P.ttf.
score_hook: Score lives in stage/item data objects inside index.js (2 refs); engine exposes stage lifecycle callbacks (6) so a game-over stage can postMessage. Needs small patch.
notes: Most-starred actively maintained JS Pac-Man; faithful ghost AI; clean two-file structure.

name: daleharvey/pacman
embed_notes: Single pacman.js + index.html + audio/. Zero build. Drop in any iframe.
reskin_notes: Everything drawn with canvas primitives; ghost colours are a small array of hex strings in pacman.js, maze is a numeric map. No image assets to swap; text strings inline.
score_hook: PACMAN global namespace; user.theScore() and a 'die' path with localStorage (3) usage. Wrap dialog('Game Over')/loseLife to postMessage.
notes: Classic minimal HTML5 Pac-Man, permissive WTFPL, trivially embeddable.

name: platzhersh/pacman-canvas
embed_notes: index.htm + pacman-canvas.js + js/pacman/{ghost,pacman}.js. Optional PHP db-handler for highscores and a node server.js can be ignored. Has ads.txt/Google verification files to strip.
reskin_notes: Ghosts are separate SVG files in img/ (blinky/pinky/inky/clyde/dazzled/dead), maze in data/map.json, UI in CSS; game title/text in index.htm.
score_hook: Global game object with game.score, endGame()/gameOver (8) and dispatchEvent (4) custom events; highscore submit function is an obvious place to postMessage.
notes: Public-domain (CC0), SVG-sprite Pac-Man still maintained in 2026; best reskin/embed balance of the Pac-Man clones.

name: masonicGIT/pacman
embed_notes: Maintained fork of shaunlebron's historical tribute (original shaunlebron/pacman now 56 stars, GPL-3). build.sh concatenates src/*.js into pacman.js which is committed; index.html loads it directly.
reskin_notes: Sprites are procedural canvas drawings in src/sprites.js; colors and text spread through src/. Includes map generator and multiple game modes. Heavy Namco-IP tribute.
score_hook: src/hud.js and game.js track score (41 refs) with localStorage high scores (10) and many callbacks (35); patch the game-over state in states.js.
notes: FLAG GPL-3. Most accurate Pac-Man/Ms. Pac-Man AI on the web, but copyleft and hard to reskin.

name: bward2/pacman-js
embed_notes: index.html loads build/app.js (committed, gulp-concatenated) + app/style. Unit-tested (coverage dir). Below star threshold but very high code quality and pushed 2026-04.
reskin_notes: Every character has its own SVG sprite sheet under app/style/graphics/spriteSheets/characters/{pacman,ghosts/blinky,...}; maze, pickups, UI logos all separate SVG/PNG files. Ideal mascot swap.
score_hook: Game communicates via window CustomEvents (dispatchEvent 12 / CustomEvent 7: e.g. awardPoints, deathSequence, gameOver) plus localStorage highScore; add a window.addEventListener to postMessage.
notes: Low stars but the most reskin-friendly Pac-Man found: per-character SVG sprites and event-driven scoring.

name: jakesgordon/javascript-tetris
embed_notes: Entire game is one index.html (inline JS/CSS) + stats.js + texture.jpg. Zero build.
reskin_notes: Piece colours are properties on the tetromino objects in the inline script; background is texture.jpg; all strings inline. Easy to edit but nothing is externalised.
score_hook: Module-level score/vscore variables and a lose() function in index.html; add postMessage inside lose().
notes: Canonical single-file JS Tetris tutorial; simplest possible embed.

name: Aerolab/blockrain.js
embed_notes: dist/blockrain.jquery.min.js + CSS; needs jQuery. $('.game').blockrain({...}). Responsive, autoplay demo mode. Unmaintained since 2018 but stable.
reskin_notes: Built-in theme system (BlockrainThemes): colours, background, textures, and fully custom PNG per block shape (assets/blocks/custom/*.png). Switch at runtime with blockrain('theme', name).
score_hook: First-class callbacks: onStart, onGameOver(score), onLine(lines, scoreIncrement, score); plus blockrain('gameover') and 'restart' methods. No patching required.
notes: Best score-hook + theme API in the whole slice; designed for embedding on third-party sites.

name: Hextris/hextris
embed_notes: index.html + js/*.js + images/*.svg; PWA manifest. GitHub API reports NOASSERTION but LICENSE.md is GPL-3.
reskin_notes: Block colours are an array in js/main.js settings, UI buttons are SVGs in images/, no character sprites. Colour/brand swap is easy; no mascot slot.
score_hook: score in main.js/view.js, localStorage high score (10), gameOver in main.js; patch gameOver() to postMessage.
notes: FLAG GPL-3. Polished, popular, mobile-friendly Tetris variant.

name: Binaryify/vue-tetris
embed_notes: docs/ contains a prebuilt bundle (index.html + static/js) that runs standalone; rebuilding needs webpack (npm run build).
reskin_notes: Brick-game handheld look done in Less/CSS; no sprites. Colours/labels in src/*.less and Vue components; i18n strings in src.
score_hook: Vuex store holds points/max; gameover flag in store (2). Subscribe to store mutation in main.js and postMessage.
notes: Vue port of the famous react-tetris but WITH a license (the React original is unlicensed).

name: ovidiuch/flatris
embed_notes: Full Next.js app with socket server, Firebase and Docker for multiplayer; single-player still requires the node build. Heavy for an iframe.
reskin_notes: Styling is CSS-in-JS inside React components; colours in shared/constants; no image assets.
score_hook: Redux game state (score/lines) in shared/reducers/game.js; dispatch listener can postMessage.
notes: Popular but over-engineered for embedding; consider only if multiplayer Tetris is wanted.

name: ttencate/tis
embed_notes: tis.min.js (4 KB) + index.html; explicitly designed as an embeddable widget with no dependencies.
reskin_notes: Colours are constants in tis.js; drawn with canvas rects; no assets.
score_hook: score variable in tis.js (4 refs) and a dispatchEvent call on game end -> listen for the custom event and postMessage.
notes: Tiny embeddable Tetris with an event on game over; good fallback/mini-widget.

name: dwmkerr/spaceinvaders
embed_notes: index.html + js/spaceinvaders.js + starfield.js + sounds/. No build; pushed 2026.
reskin_notes: Invaders/ship/bombs drawn as canvas rectangles; a config object exposes speeds, rank counts, colours partly; no sprite files. Reskin means adding drawImage calls.
score_hook: Game class with public game.score/game.lives and a state machine (GameOverState). Poll game.score or patch GameOverState.enter to postMessage.
notes: Clean, maintained, MIT Space Invaders with a proper Game/State API.

name: victorqribeiro/invaderz
embed_notes: index.html + js/{main,Player,Invader,Genetics}.js; PWA service worker (sw.js) may cache aggressively inside iframe.
reskin_notes: Invaders are procedurally generated pixel genomes (that is the gimmick); player is canvas-drawn. Colours in code; no assets.
score_hook: No explicit score variable; tracks waves/kills; gameover routine present (2) in main.js -> patch it.
notes: Novel twist (genetic-algorithm invaders) with high star count; reskin limited to colours.

name: trungvose/space-invaders-phaser-3
embed_notes: dist/ is committed (index.html + bundled JS + assets/); rebuild via rollup if source edited.
reskin_notes: All art is individual PNGs in dist/assets/images (player.png, invader.png, bullet.png, enemy-bullet.png, explode.png, starfield.png) - straight file swap.
score_hook: src/interface/manager/score-manager.ts holds score/highScore (7), game-state.ts has gameOver (5); emit postMessage from ScoreManager.
notes: Low stars, but a textbook Phaser 3 + TS structure with swappable PNG sprites.

name: chriz001/Reacteroids
embed_notes: webpack build (npm run build) -> single bundle + index.html. No prebuilt output committed.
reskin_notes: Ship/asteroids are vector polygons drawn in Ship.js/Asteroid.js; colours inline; no assets.
score_hook: React state currentScore/topScore (localStorage) in Reacteroids.js with an explicit gameOver() method (2) and endGame (4) -> postMessage there.
notes: Public-domain Asteroids; the only >200-star JS Asteroids found.

name: kevinroast/Asteroids-Reloaded
embed_notes: index.html + scripts/*.js + images/ + sounds/; license.txt is MIT (GitHub shows NOASSERTION). Includes localized messages-en/fr.txt.
reskin_notes: Sprites are PNGs in images/ (asteroid1-4, player, enemyship1, backgrounds); UI strings externalised in messages-*.txt.
score_hook: asteroids_main.js: score (52 refs), highscore (23) in localStorage, gameover routine -> patch.
notes: Low stars but a polished, effects-heavy Asteroids with real sprite files and external strings.

name: jakesgordon/javascript-breakout
embed_notes: index.html + breakout.js + game.js + levels.js + images/ + sound/; LICENSE file is MIT text (GitHub NOASSERTION). Also has a packaged Chrome-app copy.
reskin_notes: Bricks/paddle drawn with canvas; colours in breakout.js; images/paving.jpg background and up/down arrows only; levels.js data-driven.
score_hook: breakout.js: score (34), highscore + localStorage (10/5), gameover (3), lose (2) -> patch lose()/gameover.
notes: Small, MIT, level-data-driven Breakout from the same author as javascript-tetris/pong/snakes.

name: end3r/Gamedev-Canvas-workshop
embed_notes: MDN 2D Breakout tutorial; lesson10.html is the finished self-contained game (one file). GitHub shows NOASSERTION; LICENSE dedicates code to public domain (CC0).
reskin_notes: ~150 lines: colours, brick grid, text all inline constants - trivial to edit, nothing externalised.
score_hook: Global score variable; game over is alert('GAME OVER') / document.location.reload() -> replace with postMessage.
notes: Public-domain MDN Breakout; ideal minimal base to build a sponsor-branded brick game from scratch.

name: budnix/ball-and-wall
embed_notes: index.html (concatenated build) and index_dev.html (raw js/). 855 image files, level editor included. 2015, unmaintained but static.
reskin_notes: Theme 'episodes' (pegasus, space) each with own css/episodes/*.css and image sets; all bricks/paddle/backgrounds are PNGs; fonts external.
score_hook: Event emitter in game.js with emit (4) and onGameOver (3) handlers -> subscribe and postMessage.
notes: Themeable Arkanoid with a built-in level editor and onGameOver event; best breakout reskin candidate.

name: patorjk/JavaScript-Snake
embed_notes: src/index.html + src/js/snake.js run directly; parcel is only used for bundling. Pushed 2026-07.
reskin_notes: Ten CSS themes in src/css (blue, dark, golden, matrix, neon, cotton-candy...) with block PNGs in src/css/images; snake head/body/food are CSS classes -> swap images per theme.
score_hook: SNAKE.Snake object with score, isDead (5), highscore in localStorage (8/6); a handleEndCondition/gameover path to patch.
notes: Classic, maintained, theme-driven Snake with AI demo mode.

name: jakesgordon/javascript-snakes
embed_notes: index.html + snakes.js + images/ + fonts/ + sounds/ (Rakefile only for minification).
reskin_notes: 37 sprite PNGs in images/ (snake segments, food, walls) plus custom webfonts; colours/strings in snakes.js.
score_hook: snakes.js: score (56 refs), highscore (16) via localStorage, callback hooks (12), die (6) -> patch die/gameover.
notes: Sprite-based Snake with levels and high scores; more reskinnable than most Snake clones.

name: jakesgordon/javascript-pong
embed_notes: index.html + pong.js + game.js + images/ + sounds/; part1-5 folders are tutorial stages.
reskin_notes: Paddles/ball drawn as rects; only press1/press2/winner PNGs; colours in Pong config object.
score_hook: Pong.Runner with per-player scores and a goal()/win path (callback hooks 6); patch win to postMessage.
notes: The reference JS Pong tutorial; 1P vs AI or 2P local.

name: MattSkala/html5-bombergirl
embed_notes: index.html + js/*.js + img/ + sound/; bower.json only pulls EaselJS/CDN.
reskin_notes: Every entity is a separate PNG in img/ (betty, george, bomberman, bomb, fire, bonuses, tile_grass/wall/wood) - direct mascot swap.
score_hook: No numeric score (survival vs bots); GameEngine.gameOver(status) (4) with win/lose -> postMessage outcome.
notes: Only >100-star MIT Bomberman; sprite-file based; single-player vs bots or 2P local.

name: nebez/floppybird
embed_notes: index.html + js/main.js + assets/; no build; pushed 2026-02.
reskin_notes: assets/: bird.png, pipe-up/down, sky, land, ceiling, medals, scoreboard, digit fonts - all separate PNGs; CSS-positioned DOM.
score_hook: main.js: score (19 refs), highscore (11) in localStorage; playerDead()/showScore() are clear patch points.
notes: Cleanest permissive Flappy clone; all art is individual PNGs.

name: xviniette/FlappyLearning
embed_notes: index.html + game.js + Neuroevolution.js + img/. Birds are AI-controlled; there is no human input, so a small patch is needed to make it playable.
reskin_notes: img/: bird.png, pipetop.png, pipebottom.png, background.png as separate files.
score_hook: game.js: score (9), isDead (2), even a postMessage call already present (1); add a jump key handler + postMessage on death.
notes: Huge star count; needs input patch to be a game rather than a neural-net demo.

name: ellisonleao/clumsy-bird
embed_notes: index.html + js/ + data/img|sfx|bgm; build/clumsy-min.js committed. ARCHIVED (2018) but fully functional. melonJS bundled.
reskin_notes: CUSTOMIZING.md documents every asset with exact pixel sizes (bg, clumsy bird, pipe, ground, logo, getready, gameover) - designed for reskins.
score_hook: js/screens/gameover.js and HUD.js track score; patch GameOverScreen.onResetEvent to postMessage.
notes: FLAG GPL-3 + archived. Otherwise the most reskin-documented Flappy clone.

name: fossasia/flappy-svg
embed_notes: index.html + javascript/*.js + flappy.svg; ARCHIVED. GitHub shows NOASSERTION; LICENSE is CC BY 4.0 (attribution required).
reskin_notes: All graphics live in flappy.svg / flappy2.svg layers - editable in Inkscape; levels.js data-driven.
score_hook: javascript/score.js holds score; gameover in flapping.js (3) -> patch.
notes: FLAG CC-BY + archived. Vector (SVG) art makes recolouring trivial.

name: omariosouto/flappy-bird-devsoutinho
embed_notes: index.html + jogo.js + sprites.png + efeitos/*.wav. Portuguese identifiers/comments.
reskin_notes: Single sprites.png sheet with coordinates in jogo.js; swap the sheet and adjust rects.
score_hook: Score kept in the telas (screens) objects; game_over screen (3) -> postMessage in the collision handler.
notes: Tiny tutorial-grade Flappy with one spritesheet; easy to rebrand.

name: wayou/t-rex-runner
embed_notes: index.html + index.js + assets/offline-sprite-1x/2x.png. Zero build; branch gh-pages.
reskin_notes: One spritesheet (1x/2x) with all frames located by Runner.spriteDefinition coordinates - swap the sheet (README shows Kumamon/other reskins). Colours/speeds in Runner.config.
score_hook: Global Runner.instance_ with distanceRan, highestScore (5 refs) and Runner.prototype.gameOver() (2) -> monkey-patch gameOver to postMessage(distanceMeter score).
notes: The actual Chromium dino code; proven reskin path; BSD licensed.

name: chrisdothtml/chrome-dino
embed_notes: index.html + lib/ ES modules + assets/sprite.png; published to npm as chrome-dino.
reskin_notes: assets/sprite.png single sheet with coordinates in lib/sprites.js; actors split into Dino/Cactus/Bird/Cloud classes.
score_hook: lib/game/DinoGame.js: score (16), gameOver (4), endGame (3) -> patch endGame.
notes: Low stars but a clean modular rewrite of the dino game; easier to modify than Chromium's.

name: robertkleffner/mariohtml5
embed_notes: main.html + enjine.min.js + mario.min.js + images/ + sounds/ + midi/. No build.
reskin_notes: Sprite sheets in images/ (mariosheet, enemysheet, mapsheet, bgsheet...); reskinning REQUIRED because bundled art is Nintendo IP.
score_hook: No score counter (coins/lives); loseState/winState + isDead (4)/gameover (12) -> postMessage from LoseState.
notes: FLAG Nintendo art. Public-domain port of Infinite Mario with procedural levels.

name: pablogozalvez/Super-Mario-Phaser
embed_notes: index.html + javascript/*.js + assets/; Phaser from CDN; deployed via GitHub Pages workflow.
reskin_notes: assets/ has one PNG per entity/block/collectible (overworld + underground sets) and per-state player sprites; settings.js for tunables. Art is Nintendo IP - must be replaced.
score_hook: javascript/hud-control.js: score (25), localStorage (29), gameOver (7) -> patch.
notes: FLAG Nintendo art. Most granular sprite layout of the Mario clones.

name: JSLegendDev/Mario-Game-Kaboom.js
embed_notes: index.html + main.js ES modules + libs/kaboom + assets/ + Tiled JSON maps in content/. No build.
reskin_notes: Original (non-Nintendo) art: every tile, enemy, Player.png, Coin.png, backgrounds are separate PNGs; levels in Tiled maps.
score_hook: gameover scene (2); coins collected tracked in entities -> emit postMessage in the gameover scene.
notes: IP-safe Mario-style platformer with per-file sprites; ideal mascot platformer despite low stars.

name: iamkun/tower_game
embed_notes: index.html + dist/ bundle committed; src/ rebuild via webpack/babel.
reskin_notes: assets/: block.png, block-perfect, hook, rope, backgrounds, c1-c8/f1-f7 skyline layers, modal UI PNGs - all separate files.
score_hook: index.html/index.js expose the game instance with score (12 refs) and success/failed callbacks in the config object -> postMessage in failedCallback.
notes: Mobile-first, share-friendly hyper-casual stacker; asset-driven and callback-based.

name: gd4Ark/star-battle
embed_notes: index.html + js/ + img/ + sound/; no build.
reskin_notes: img/plane/{player,enemy,friend}.png, bullets, meteorites, stars, background, UI buttons all separate PNGs.
score_hook: js/scene/over.js + play.js track score (15 refs); scene callbacks (11) -> postMessage in over scene.
notes: Closest permissive substitute for Galaga (no true Galaga clone with >20 stars exists in JS).

name: MattSurabian/DuckHunt-JS
embed_notes: dist/ committed (index.html, duckhunt.js, sprites.png/json atlas, audio); source rebuild via webpack/gulp.
reskin_notes: src/assets/images has individual PNG frames per animation (duck colours, dog) packed into an atlas by gulp; swap PNGs and rebuild atlas.
score_hook: src/modules/Game.js: score (16) and level/wave handling; add postMessage in the lose/game-over branch.
notes: FLAG Nintendo IP (title/art style, custom-drawn). Polished, maintained Pixi shooter.

name: TomMalbran/games
embed_notes: Each game is its own folder with index.html + source/*.js + design/style.css + audio/; root index.html is a launcher. No build.
reskin_notes: Visuals are largely CSS-driven (design/style.css per game) with fonts; Pac-Man/Snake draw via canvas code; no sprite PNGs to swap but styling is centralised per game.
score_hook: Every game has source/Score.js + HighScores.js (localStorage) and endGame/gameOver in Main.js -> uniform patch point across all seven games.
notes: MULTI-GAME: seven consistent MIT clones sharing utils/ - one integration pattern covers all.

name: channingbreeze/games
embed_notes: 98 folders each with index.html + game.js/main.js + assets/; Phaser loaded per game. Chinese UI text and some WeChat share hooks to strip.
reskin_notes: Each game keeps PNG/WAV assets in its own assets/ dir (e.g. flappybird/assets/bird.png, pipes.png, background.png) loaded by name in preload() -> file swap.
score_hook: Widespread gameover (16), topScore/bestScore + localStorage (9-11) patterns in game.js; per-game patch in the game-over state.
notes: MULTI-GAME GOLD: ~98 small Phaser arcade games under MIT from phaser-china; covers Flappy, Dino, Pac-Man, Tetris, Breakout, 2048 in one repo.

name: kunjgit/GameZone
embed_notes: 733 game folders (Hacktoberfest contributions) each static HTML/CSS/JS; root index.html is a catalogue. Quality and asset provenance vary widely - vet each game.
reskin_notes: Varies per game: many use CSS/inline shapes, some ship PNG sprites. Expect 2-4 per game.
score_hook: Inconsistent; most have a gameOver() function and localStorage highscore (gameover 11, localStorage 6 in sampled files).
notes: MULTI-GAME (quantity over quality): Apache-2.0 umbrella covers Frogger, Doodle Jump, Space Invaders which lack standalone >200-star repos.

name: abagames/crisp-game-lib
games: 100+ one-file arcade mini-games in docs/ (snake1, froooog, dinos, raid, survivor, pinclimb, jujump, etc.)
embed_notes: docs/<game>/index.html + main.js per game loading the lib bundle; docs/ is a GitHub Pages site. Library also on npm.
reskin_notes: Characters are ASCII pixel-art strings defined in each main.js (characters = [...]) plus a theme option (simple/pixel/shape/crt/dark); recolour/re-pixel in code, no image files.
score_hook: Lib manages score, highscore (localStorage) and end() -> a single patch to the lib's gameOver (7 refs in main.ts) instruments every game at once.
notes: MULTI-GAME GOLD for volume: one lib patch = score hook for 100+ tiny arcade games; retro pixel look, mobile-ready.

name: KilledByAPixel/LittleJS
embed_notes: examples/<name>/index.html load dist/littlejs.js directly; no build for examples. Engine actively maintained (2026-08).
reskin_notes: Examples use tile sheets (tiles.png) with tile indices in code; swap the sheet to reskin; colours via engine Color objects.
score_hook: Engine has gameInit/gameUpdate callbacks (15); examples keep a score variable and a game-over branch you patch; no built-in event.
notes: MULTI-GAME (engine + examples): production-quality breakout & platformer examples under MIT; strong base for bespoke sponsor games.

name: 16Yongjin/html-games
embed_notes: Each game is ONE self-contained .html file; zero dependencies.
reskin_notes: Everything inline (colours, text); no asset files - quick to edit, nothing externalised.
score_hook: tetris.html/brick-breaker.html/stack.html have score (21 refs), localStorage (8), gameOver (4), isDead (4) -> patch inline.
notes: MULTI-GAME micro: single-file games are the easiest possible iframe drops.

name: chvin/react-tetris
embed_notes: NO LICENSE FILE - unusable for redistribution despite 8.7k stars. Use Binaryify/vue-tetris (MIT) which replicates it.
reskin_notes: CSS-based brick-game handheld; n/a without license.
score_hook: Redux store; n/a.
notes: FLAG: most-starred Tetris on GitHub has no license - do not use.

name: meth-meth-method/super-mario
embed_notes: NO LICENSE (YouTube tutorial series code) + Nintendo art. Unusable.
reskin_notes: JSON sprite/level specs in public/ - would be great if licensed.
score_hook: n/a
notes: FLAG unlicensed; listed so nobody chases it. JSLegendDev/Mario-Game-Kaboom.js is the licensed alternative.

name: SimonHung/LodeRunner_TotalRecall
embed_notes: Static and feature-complete (level editor, colour themes in lodeRunner.colorTheme.js, gamepad) but NO LICENSE and Broderbund IP.
reskin_notes: colorTheme.js + image/ folder exist; n/a without license.
score_hook: lodeRunner.hiscore.js; n/a.
notes: FLAG unlicensed. Only serious JS Lode Runner; would need author permission.
